svg.title: MerciMed — System Architecture
svg.desc: Full system architecture for MerciMed: Flutter app, Supabase backend, AI pipeline with RAG, and static reference data

g.text: Auth · File manager · AI chat · Family sharing
Supabase — auth · storage · postgres · pgvector · realtime
Context: patient records + RAG results + static DB
Answers symptoms · recommends doctors · web search

svg.text: Web search (Brave / Tavily API) — triggered by chatbot when user asks for external info
Supabase edge functions handle AI calls server-side (no API key exposed to client)
